title: workspaces.json (v2)
notes: NO version field. "v2" is a naming convention only: the workspace key is the registered path's folder basename and is NEVER stored.
There is no archive-state field: archiving is a pure filesystem move into .celestea-archived/, and the scanner skips dot-dirs.

legacyV1.name: tolerated on load, used for the name->basename mapping, never written back

hardErrors.malformed: workspaces.json '<path>' is malformed: {e} (startup exits 1; the unreadable registry is never overwritten)
hardErrors.duplicateBasename: two workspaces resolve to the same folder name '{base}' (workspace keys must be unique basenames; rename one folder)

sessionId.rules: exactly one '/', both sides non-empty, session segment has no '/' and is sanitized (separators/control/whitespace -> '_', CJK preserved); empty/'.'/'..'/leading-dot rejected; dir.parent() must equal the workspace path
